research_question: Can a small posterior-conditioned analytic JNR estimator improve only MFT/VFT/ISRJ JNR estimates on new paired-power identities while leaving the frozen P4c classification and other nine parameters bit-identical?

candidate.input: P5b1 26-D fixed analytic feature bank plus frozen base six-label sigmoid posterior
candidate.head: one-hidden-layer MLP, 64 hidden units, three outputs MFT/VFT/ISRJ JNR
candidate.training: masked SmoothL1, AdamW lr=0.001 wd=0.0001, max 30 epochs, patience 5, model seeds 14041/14042/14043
candidate.attachment: replace only active target values at MFT.JNR column27, VFT.JNR column48, ISRJ.JNR column52; retain the base prediction for all other entries

evaluation.oracle_gated: JNR error where the true label is active and parameter mask is valid
evaluation.predicted_gated: same JNR error restricted by the unchanged frozen base classification decision
evaluation.classification_invariance: logits, probabilities and all thresholded decisions must be exactly equal before/after attachment
evaluation.other_parameter_invariance: all non-target JNR entries and all 9 non-JNR selected parameters must be bit-identical before/after attachment

decision_rule.pass: Freeze the bounded attachment and perform separately preregistered two-new-identity confirmation before any broader system claim.
decision_rule.fail: Retain frozen P4c. Do not tune the head, add a router, change classification thresholds, or extend the attachment.
